document-formats.title: Document & File Formats (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, draw.io)

spokes.routingLine: PDF expert — create, parse, manipulate, merge, split, watermark, encrypt, sign, validate, and convert PDF files in Python and Node.js.
Word document (.docx) expert — create, read, edit, and manipulate .docx files using docx-js (JavaScript) and XML editing.
Excel/spreadsheet expert — create, read, edit, and fix .xlsx files using openpyxl and pandas in Python.
PowerPoint (.pptx) expert — create, read, edit, and manipulate presentations programmatically using PptxGenJS (Node.js) and python-pptx (Python).
CSV/TSV expert — parse, generate, validate, convert, and stream delimited-text files in Python and Node.js.
Advanced JSON manipulation beyond basic parse/stringify — streaming parsers, JSON Schema
Programmatic draw.io/diagrams.net (.drawio) file creation, parsing, manipulation, and export.
